quest.title: Follow the Wind
quest.description: The grand final of the Crux Clash is about to begin, and you will soon meet your opponent. Victory is but one step away...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x700, Primogem x60, Mora x34075, Guide to Prosperity x2, Guide to Diligence x2, Guide to Gold x2, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

talks.objective: Enter the arena to fight the final round

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Huh, why isn't he here yet...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: #Never mind, we can start by making your entrance first, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Everyone, listen up. Your attention, please!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: We've reached the climax of The Crux Clash. This is the final match!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: We've seen many exciting battles today, and now, at long last, the two finalists have emerged.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: #Now, I'd like to introduce our first combatant. Though few have seen {F#her}{M#him}, {F#her}{M#his} reputation knows no bounds.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: #{F#She}{M#He} strikes fear into the heart of Osial and the mere mention of {F#her}{M#his} name causes even Fatui Harbingers to turn pale in the face... Introducing Liyue's traveling hero, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Clash Competitor
dialogues.text: Wooooow!!!

dialogues.speaker: Clash Competitor
dialogues.text: I've been waiting for this moment!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: #I'm sure everyone witnessed {F#her}{M#his} thrilling match in the semi-finals.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: But today's final round will surely take things up a notch!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: As for our other combatant... Uh, he still hasn't arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: C'mon, what could be taking him so long? You can't just forfeit for not showing up like in previous rounds... This is the finals!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Apologies! Everyone just sit tight!

choices.text: Maybe they got the match time mixed up?

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: We've got no other choice... If he doesn't show up we'll just have to postpone the match.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Wait a moment. Something doesn't seem right about this.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Captain Beidou, perhaps we should check on the prize.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, come with us.

choices.text: Maybe they're too intimidated to show up for the finals?

talks.objective: Go check the box containing the Vision
Follow Kazuha to track down the Vision

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Let me see...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: It's gone alright... The Vision is missing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh! Did somebody steal it? Who would dare do such a thing in broad daylight?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: We don't know when it was taken exactly.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Huh! I never thought that someone here would have the guts to cross Captain Beidou.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: No need to worry, even the craftiest sleight of hand does not escape nature's watchful gaze.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm... The culprit has only acted recently. They will not have gotten far.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The Vision was the prize that I had offered, and it was my responsibility to look after it. I will be certain to get it back.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Well, if you insist. I'll leave the matter to you then.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I'll stay here and try to offer some explanation to all the spectators that came to see the match.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: #If you would, please come with me, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: Seems there's nothing else we can do.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm, but we're on an island, where could he have possibly run to?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Come with me. I can sense the winds are coming.

choices.text: My opponent was a no-show anyway.

talks.objective: Go to the wind current location

dialogues.speaker: Zhuhan
dialogues.text: Please make your way to the arena. Captain Beidou is waiting.

talks.objective: Proceed to the small island ahead and search for clues
Defeat the Treasure Hoarders blocking the way
Talk to the Treasure Hoarder who stole the Vision

dialogues.speaker: Fei the Flyer
dialogues.text: You caught up with me... How is that possible!?

dialogues.speaker: Fei the Flyer
dialogues.text: I had even prepared a boat to ensure a quick getaway, and still, you caught up to me.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: No boat could ever match the speed of the wind.

dialogues.speaker: Fei the Flyer
dialogues.text: The wind? What are you talking about? Oh, I get it... your Vision!

dialogues.speaker: Fei the Flyer
dialogues.text: Drat, if only I had a Vision... Or if I could activate this one, then you'd never be able to catch me!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: This has nothing to do with Visions. You may be skilled at vanishing from a crowd, but it seems you know precious little about how to conceal yourself from nature's gaze.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Additionally, your chosen escape route was flawed for reasons that are too numerous to go into, and on top of that, I could hear your boasting and proud laughter in the wind as I was pursuing you.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: In other words, you failed to meet any of the basic criteria for a grand heist: namely speed, stealth, and style.

dialogues.speaker: Fei the Flyer
dialogues.text: You... You!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: But most disappointing of all is the state of the Vision in your hand.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It appears that the Vision doesn't respond to human desire indiscriminately.

dialogues.speaker: Fei the Flyer
dialogues.text: Fine, fine! I admit it!

dialogues.speaker: Fei the Flyer
dialogues.text: I've had my eyes on this Vision for quite some time now. I decided to register after hearing that this fighting contest was full of a bunch of lousy fighters. I fought my way to the finals and...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aha, so you were supposed to be our opponent!

dialogues.speaker: Fei the Flyer
dialogues.text: I'd intended to win the contest through skill alone all along, but then you showed up!

dialogues.speaker: Fei the Flyer
dialogues.text: After watching the semi-finals, I knew that I didn't stand a chance. But I wasn't about to give up on the Vision so easily after coming all this way.

dialogues.speaker: Fei the Flyer
dialogues.text: Since there was no use in trying to face you in the match, I decided to put my skills to good use while everyone's attention was on you and Beidou.

dialogues.speaker: Fei the Flyer
dialogues.text: I was convinced I'd prepared thoroughly for my escape... but somehow, you still managed to catch up to me.

choices.text: You've got nowhere else to run now, just give it up.

response.speaker: Fei the Flyer
response.text: Ugh... Drat... This could — this should have gone differently...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: There'll be consequences if you resist any further.

response.speaker: Fei the Flyer
response.text: Hah! I know an empty threat when I hear one!

response.speaker: Fei the Flyer
response.text: Fine... but you'd better mean it! It didn't activate once I took it anyway, it's nothing but a useless shell to me.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: You know, according to the laws of the sea, the penalty for stealing is breaking the culprit's arms...

response.speaker: Fei the Flyer
response.text: Huh! You're not serious, are you!?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Not to mention that the item you stole was a prize, you didn't show up for the final match, and you damaged the reputation of the captain of The Crux Fleet.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: It seems that it would be only fair to brand the word "thief" on your forehead with a hot iron.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, whoa, we don't need to go that far, do we?

response.speaker: Fei the Flyer
response.text: Ugh, I never would have guessed you could be so cruel.

response.speaker: Fei the Flyer
response.text: If this is where talking gets me, then forget it. I'll risk a fight!

choices.text: Hand over the Vision.

response.speaker: Fei the Flyer
response.text: After all I went through to get it? I think not!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Just do as we say and there'll be no further consequences.

response.speaker: Fei the Flyer
response.text: R—Really?

choices.text: If you give up the Vision, we'll let you go.

talks.objective: Talk to the Treasure Hoarder again

dialogues.speaker: Fei the Flyer
dialogues.text: A—Argh!

dialogues.speaker: Fei the Flyer
dialogues.text: No, no! Do what you want, but please, don't brand my forehead, please!!!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm... He has persevered to the bitter end, and now death looms near... yet still, the gods do not bestow their favor upon him.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: ...Put down the Vision and leave. I've changed my mind... No further punishment for you.

dialogues.speaker: Fei the Flyer
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: What's wrong? Are you asking for more punishment?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It's up to you. Such willingness is commendable and fits the way of the samurai.

dialogues.speaker: Fei the Flyer
dialogues.text: N—No, no need for that. Thank you for releasing me. You truly are generous!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, Paimon doesn't get it. Were you just trying to scare him?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I take no pleasure in frightening others. I was just testing all possibilities while the Vision remained in his hands.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: When people are forced into a corner, that is when their greatest strength will appear. I thought it may be an opportunity for him to awaken the Vision.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: But unfortunately, nothing happened.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you were planning this all along?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes, I wanted to know whether it were possible for an extinguished Vision to be reawakened.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: From the moment he stole the Vision, I decided to use him for this experiment.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I have tried many other methods in the past.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Though few tales tell of a "masterless Vision reawakening"...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: After seeing you command multiple elements, I figured that nothing is impossible.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Come, why don't you give it a try? Let's see if you can give me the answer I'm hoping for.

choices.text: I'll try.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, the Vision didn't seem to respond at all.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I see... So you are also unable to rekindle the Vision.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: ...No matter, this was expected. I suppose this Vision is still mine to take for now.

choices.text: Why are you so attached to this Vision?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, what's the story behind this Vision, anyway?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: The story begins with an old friend...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Perhaps one day I may come to find that all I have done is meaningless.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: But as a wandering samurai, I find meaning in traveling and the sprawling beauty of nature that lies along the way, while still retaining the "warrior way" in my heart.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kazuha...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Hehe, it's just another way of saying I do as I please.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Alright then. It's time we returned.

choices.text: Let's go.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Allow me to gather the wind for us once more.

choices.text: If you need to talk more, I'm here to listen.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: ...Do not let my feelings trouble you.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: But thank you.

choices.text: Why are you so determined to rekindle the Vision?

talks.objective: Return to the Guyun Stone Forest arena

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Did Beidou leave already? Maybe she went back to her ship?

dialogues.speaker: Zhuhan
dialogues.text: If you're looking for the Captain, she was summoned by Lady Ningguang.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuhan
dialogues.text: It seems that The Crux Clash got out of hand this time and has attracted her attention.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuhan
dialogues.text: Captain Beidou was muttering something about Ningguang being a stick-in-the-mud as she headed off to Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Haha, it's not unusual for those two to be at odds with one another.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuhan
dialogues.text: But still, Captain Beidou was disappointed she didn't get to witness the crowning of the new champion. She had been looking forward to it for quite some time.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The one who stole the Vision was originally to be this hero's opponent in the final round.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: He knew he stood no chance of winning the match, thus the wicked idea of stealing the prize took hold in his mind.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: In which case, The Crux Clash comes to a clear-cut conclusion.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuhan
dialogues.text: Huh? So that's what happened!?

dialogues.speaker: Zhuhan
dialogues.text: If that's the case, then the rules stipulate that he is disqualified... and our hero here is the champion!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thought we'd win and all, but not like this...

dialogues.speaker: Zhuhan
dialogues.text: It doesn't matter, as the saying goes, "honor given is honor deserved." Now, let me go prepare the champion's medal to award you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So will we be able to travel to Inazuma now?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes, I believe so. Though Captain Beidou is no longer present here, I'll be sure she receives word of it. She is a woman of her word.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: But the voyage to Inazuma is a treacherous one. You will be plagued by a perpetual tempest the entire trip.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: In fact, the relentless rain and wind are also an embodiment of the Raiden Shogun's will to close the nation.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hold on a second, you're saying she can change the weather just with the power of her mind!?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Let us not forget that this is one of the Seven Archons. If Liyue's Morax could form Guyun Stone Forest by casting down his stone spears, then it should come as no great surprise that the Raiden Shogun is capable of summoning an eternal tempest.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Suffice it to say that if you wish to journey to Inazuma, the Alcor will need some time. You will be notified once all the preparations have been made.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: In the meantime, I intend to embark on a journey of my own. I will travel all across the vast lands of Liyue, in the hope of finding a way to reawaken the Vision.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon believes you'll find a way for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Thank you. May both our journeys prove meaningful.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: One final word of warning. The part of your journey that lies after the storm may well prove to be the most arduous.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I'll stay behind and explain the situation here. Just get the Vision back.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: The spectators were all geared up to see an exciting match. I can't let them return disappointed.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: There you have it, the evidence speaks for itself. It's no wonder Lady Ningguang was so concerned with the security of this area.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: I doubt even Captain Beidou will manage to come out of all of this unscathed.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You're up! I wish you luck.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I await the results of this match with great anticipation.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? A wind current?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The winds have come at an opportune moment. Let's seize this chance.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Ride the winds upward. From there, we can continue our search for clues.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: By the way, what made you suddenly think of checking the prize in the first place?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I heard it the moment it was stolen.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well then why didn't you stop him!?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You'll see. Shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: Hello! Would you like to give Theater Mechanicus a go? It's loads of fun!

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: I'll play a round.

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: Certainly! You may start whenever you like.

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: What's Theater Mechanicus?

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: Theater Mechanicus is a new kind of board game that I just invented.

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: All you need to play is a table, a few game pieces, and a game master.

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: The objective of the game is to use various strategies to withstand the monster attacks. At least, that's the main idea for now...

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: But who knows, if any more good ideas come to me, I'd like to expand the game's content even more.

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: It'd be great to add things like exploring ruins, or solving evil plots... If all goes well, the game could potentially become like a true adventure in another world.

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: How much does it cost to play?

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: Well, I've only just finished designing this board game and would like to hear what people think of such a game.

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: So, during the Lantern Rite, it won't cost anyone a single Mora to play. All you need is a Xiao Lantern and you can play one round.

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: If you'd like to give it a try, just let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: Farewell. If you'd like to give Theater Mechanicus a go, just let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Xiaoyan
dialogues.text: ...an epic fight. Legendary. The skies went black, there were howling winds and waves as high as houses. So the vile demon struck again, this time with all his might... but the adeptus just managed to dodge it! It was a powerful hit indeed; landed square on Mt. Tianheng! Boom!

choices.text: (Keep listening)

response.speaker: Xiaoyan
response.text: How powerful was the hit? Try powerful enough to tear open the base of the mountain!

response.speaker: Xiaoyan
response.text: "A slight crack in the foundation; what's the big deal," you say? Well, let me tell you. Suddenly, there was a thunderous sound of giant rocks rolling down the mountains: The whole of Mt. Tianheng was on the verge of collapse! Meanwhile, down in the village, everyone stared up at the sight of impending doom and trembled with fear.

response.speaker: Xiaoyan
response.text: Skybracer knew that if he didn't act quickly, the entire village was going to be reduced to a pulp! Oh, the humanity...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh, the humanity!

response.speaker: Xiaoyan
response.text: This was it. It was now or never... Suddenly, the adeptus had a brainwave. "Aha! My antlers..."

response.speaker: Xiaoyan
response.text: Now. As we all know, the pair of antlers on Skybracer's head were a gift from the Lord of Geo. And what a magnificent gift they were: They were ten feet long and a hundred times harder than the hardest iron you can imagine...

response.speaker: Xiaoyan
response.text: That's when he summoned a fellow adeptus.

response.speaker: Xiaoyan
response.text: This masked companion was also a formidable fighter. He took a deep breath, and then with one almighty strike from his polearm he tore the antlers clean off the adeptus' head. Crash! They came tumbling to the ground...

response.speaker: Xiaoyan
response.text: Skybracer picked the antlers up off the floor. His own antlers. A piece of his very own body. And he thrust them into the foot of Mt. Tianheng! Guess what happened next?

response.speaker: Xiaoyan
response.text: It stopped the mountain from falling down — yes... but it also raised the mountain to thousands of feet higher than it had stood before!

choices.text: Wow!

response.speaker: Xiaoyan
response.text: ...My friends, do not think of this antler removal as anything remotely similar to a haircut. Antlers are made of bone, and grow straight out of the skull.

response.speaker: Xiaoyan
response.text: What was that gushing sound? Blood, spraying out from Skybracer's head like a fountain, coating everything in sight!

response.speaker: Xiaoyan
response.text: The adeptus grotesquely wiped his hand across his blood-soaked skull, and began racing back up the mountain to wipe the vile demon off the face of the earth. You can imagine how ferocious he looked now, all covered in blood with murder in his eyes! A great adeptus? More like a king of the demons!

response.speaker: Xiaoyan
response.text: Still, to the people who lived below the mountain, Skybracer was their savior, a great and merciful adeptus who had saved them all from certain doom. In fact, they thought more highly of him than they thought of the Lord of Geo.

response.speaker: Xiaoyan
response.text: The rain continued to pour down, and the gutters began to swell...

response.speaker: Xiaoyan
response.text: But no one really knew how much of it was the rain, and how much was the grateful tears of a rescued people... nor did anyone know how much was the spilled blood of Skybracer...

choices.text: (Stop listening)

response.speaker: Xiaoyan
response.text: ...Friends, those antlers; I'm telling you...

choices.text: (Stop listening)

response.speaker: Xiaoyan
response.text: How powerful was the hit? I'll tell you...

dialogues.speaker: Jingming
dialogues.text: Hello, how may I help you?

choices.text: Please tell me about Xiao Lanterns...

response.speaker: Jingming
response.text: Xiao Lantern-making is a traditional craft form at Lantern Rite. It's quite technical, you need to cut the paper, insert the wick, add wish sticks, paint it...

response.speaker: Jingming
response.text: Sounds like quite an ordeal, huh? Fortunately, if you know how to use a Crafting Bench, it makes things much easier these days.

response.speaker: Jingming
response.text: Hopefully, the gods don't think that cheapens the wishes we make.

response.speaker: Jingming
response.text: The Crafting Bench is over there. Why not give it a try? The Lantern Rite only comes once a year.

choices.text: Goodbye.

response.speaker: Jingming
response.text: May the flames of wisdom spread to all, and never be extinguished.

dialogues.speaker: Yi'nian
dialogues.text: Ah, a customer! What can I get for you? How about some Lantern Rite specialties? We only make them once a year!

choices.text: I'd like to buy a snack.

response.speaker: Yi'nian
response.text: Certainly! Take a look and decide for yourself. I can do anything on the menu. Or if there's something in particular you're after, I can do that instead!

choices.text: How's business these days?

response.speaker: Yi'nian
response.text: Haha, business is better than ever. Thanks for asking.

response.speaker: Yi'nian
response.text: But if you ask me, making good food is what really counts. Perfecting tasty snacks is time well spent, rather than thinking all day about how to make more advertisements.

response.speaker: Yi'nian
response.text: If it's good, it'll sell itself. At least, that's what I think. I don't need any boring advice from Wang'ya.

choices.text: Goodbye.

response.speaker: Yi'nian
response.text: Take care. Please come again!

dialogues.speaker: Chen the Sharp
dialogues.text: All this walking around working up your appetite? Why not curb your hunger with a freshly grilled Tiger Fish?

dialogues.speaker: Chen the Sharp
dialogues.text: As it happens, this year's Mingxiao Lantern commemorates Skybracer; back in the day, grilled Tiger Fish was his favorite.

dialogues.speaker: Chen the Sharp
dialogues.text: This year's Lantern Rite experience isn't complete until you've tried one!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to buy a snack.

dialogues.speaker: Chen the Sharp
dialogues.text: You've come to the right place. We've got sizzling hot Grilled Tiger Fish.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you say that every year?

dialogues.speaker: Chen the Sharp
dialogues.text: Haha... Yes, I do! I say the same thing every year, but I'm never lying.

dialogues.speaker: Chen the Sharp
dialogues.text: It says so in the Historia Naturalis Liyue: a thousand years ago, all the adepti loved eating grilled Tiger Fish...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Chen the Sharp
dialogues.text: If you get peckish when you're browsing around Xiao Market, come and find me!

dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: ...Mommy always used to take us to Xiao Market...

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Yeah! Mommy would buy toys for us, take us to see the Xiao Lanterns... And she'd carry you when you got tired...

dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: ...Yi Zhu, I miss Mommy.

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Yi Xian... Don't cry, let's make a Xiao Lantern for Mommy, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: Huh? But I thought Xiao Lanterns were to remember the heroes who look after us...

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: You're right. Well, our mommy was a hero and she looked after us, didn't she?

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: So come on, wipe your tears away — let's welcome back Mommy's spirit and all the other heroes with big smiles on our faces!

dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: Yeah!

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Hi... Are you looking for me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: I'm Yi Zhu. You probably know my little sister, Yi Xian?

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: I promised Yi Xian that we would make a Xiao Lantern together for Mommy, but I couldn't gather the materials we needed. Thankfully, Changshun specially set aside some materials for us to use...

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Everyone's been so good to me and my sister... *sniff*

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: *sniff* ...No, I can't cry... I can't let Yi Xian see me unhappy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Goodbye... May the flames of wisdom spread to all, and never be extinguished.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Hi, I'm Linlang. I run an antiques shop called Xigu Antiques... How may I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please tell me about the Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: There's an abiding sense of nostalgia in the air during the Lantern Rite... Normally I only get that feeling in my shop; I love it, it makes me feel so at home.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Lantern Rite is much more ancient than any of the antiques in my shop, though.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Antiquity has real value. I should know, I make my living off that fact. So make the most of this very precious time of year.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Please enjoy this special time filled with the splendor of antiquity.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Hi! I'm the Manager of the Maritime Authority, and I'm in a fantastic mood right now!

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Mmm, feel that sea breeze... Go on, close your eyes and just feel it for a second... Do you it feel it too?

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: ...Freedom! Hahahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: No more fishing boats and cargo ships trying to get in and out of the harbor; no more application forms and approval forms... For a few days, I can forget all about it!

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Praise be to the Lord of Geo!

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: I'm Changchang, I just donated Dolly. She's my ragdoll.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Last night in my dream, Dolly told me her wish was to fly up into the sky and see the view.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: So I gave her to the lady over by the big deer lantern. Dolly's wish will come true now, won't it?

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: I did the right thing, didn't I? Wishes are supposed to come true at the Lantern Rite, aren't they?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: May the flames of wisdom spread to all, and never be extinguished.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: This is the Lantern Rite Gala, where everyone gathers for Lantern Rite. As one of the head planners for the event, is there anything I can assist with?

choices.text: Please tell me about the Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: Lantern Rite is an annual festival everyone in Liyue celebrates. It takes place on the night of the first full moon of the year.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: During the five-day festival, people pray for peace, ward off evil spirits, and watch the lanterns. We believe the fire's light keeps wisdom alive, and guides fallen heroes home along the sea.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: It's a popular tradition to make the Mingxiao Lantern as well as smaller Xiao Lanterns and then release them into the night sky.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: The lanterns light the path for the souls of our fallen heroes as they travel by cover of night. We hope the lanterns will guide them back home so they can be reunited with us here.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: This is an extremely important festival, one which deserves meticulous preparation in every detail. It is my honor to be working as a planner.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: Please be sure to visit the Xiao Market when you have the chance, that's where the most lively festivities can be found. I hope you thoroughly enjoy yourselves and participate in all the festivities on offer.

choices.text: I'd like to know more about the Lantern Rite traditions.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: What would you like to know about? There's the Mingxiao Lantern, Xiao Market, as well as the Xiao Lanterns... I'd be happy to tell you all I know.

choices.text: What is the Mingxiao Lantern for?

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: Long, long ago, the heroes and the people joined forces to protect the land of Liyue.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: Since peace was restored, the tradition of everyone coming together to build a giant floating lantern has been observed as a way of keeping that spirit of unity alive.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: Everyone who can collects materials, donates what they can spare, and helps with the construction work. And on the final night of the festival, the whole city watches as the lantern is released into the air. It's the tradition most integral to the Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: Do you see the huge stone in the middle of the lantern? It's the largest Plaustrite unearthed this year.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: How big the Mingxiao Lantern is depends on the size of the biggest Plaustrite from the preceding year. This year is special, because it has the biggest chunk of Plaustrite found in twenty years.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: In honor of the great heroes who died to protect Liyue, the Mingxiao Lantern's design is always based on the adeptus form of one of the heroes.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: This year's Mingxiao Lantern depicts the noble form of Skybracer. The Yuehai Pavilion chose the theme based on popular demand.

choices.text: What's the Xiao Market?

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: To put it simply, it's one of the attractions for visitors to the festival.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: A substantial portion of the funding for the Mingxiao Lantern comes from vendors at the market.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: So although Liyue Harbor's business people can sometimes seem a little tight-fisted, when it comes down to it they're all good people.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: While everyone's out for the festival, you could certainly talk to them and get to know them a bit.

choices.text: What are Xiao Lanterns?

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: Good question. As you might have guessed, you can't have a Lantern Rite without lanterns!

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: Before releasing it into the air, people will write their wishes on wish sticks and insert them into the lantern. The lantern then carries their wishes off into the night sky.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: Liyue may be well known for its mining industry, but fortunately, being surrounded by rocks hasn't turned people's hearts to stone...

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: Maybe it's because we also live off the sea. That romantic idea of the gentle sea breeze has found its way into our hearts... Haha.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: Would you care to try making your own Xiao Lantern? After all, it's not every day you get to be in Liyue during the Lantern Rite.

choices.text: Not right now, thanks.

response.speaker: Jiangzhou
response.text: Okay. Well, enjoy your time here.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: This year's Mingxiao Lantern is dedicated to Skybracer... He always was a show off — I'm sure he'll be very pleased!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who's Skybracer?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: This year's Mingxiao Lantern will be the spitting image of him when it's complete!

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Well, that's the plan. I do hope they make the antlers big enough, they were his pride and joy after all.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: The story goes that the antlers were made from the very essence of Rex Lapis' divine power, which made it the hardest material in all of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: But then, that fateful battle happened... The gods exchanged powerful blows, and the mountains started collapsing. To avoid impacting the villagers at the foot of the mountain, the adeptus got his friend to chop his antlers off...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: He used those blood-drenched antlers as a wedge to prop up the mountain. And if that wasn't enough of a sacrifice, he then kept on fighting until his blood was drained and his life ran out...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Thanks to him, Mt. Tianheng still stands tall and proud to this day. And the blood that he lost in the battle turned into the Bishui River.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Hehehe... Whether you believe the story or not, I'm just happy that you're willing to hear me tell it.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Surely, the reason Lantern Rite exists is because people throughout the ages have chosen to come together as friends rather than stay in isolation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Goodbye. May the flames of wisdom spread to all, and never be extinguished.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I'm Musheng, I come from out in the country. There's definitely more of a festive atmosphere in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: The heroes that we remember during Lantern Rite are actually adepti who lived in Liyue in the distant past.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: That was a time when the adepti lived among the normal people. I don't know why we never see any adepti nowadays...

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I can't help but think it's a bad omen... Ah, what am I saying? I shouldn't jinx the festival, should I? Haha.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: H—Hello... Judging from your attire, we must be from the same place, no?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Hmm? Ah yes, hello. Sorry, I seldom meet other Snezhnayans around here.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: The Lantern Rite sure is beautiful, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Yes, but it seems that there's still much to come yet. The Mingxiao Lantern is the height of the festivities. At least, that's what I've heard.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Ah yes, so it seems. I've only just arrived here recently... I've come here alone, so there are still many things I don't quite understand yet.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Oh? I've also arrived recently myself, so I often come here alone to watch the ships sail in from Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: ...Though I know that these boats rolling in and out of the port are not the ones to take me back home. Huh, what a coincidence... I also often come and watch the boats here.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Are you sure we've never met before?

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Could we have met before? Perhaps my memory is failing me... I apologize, it would be impolite if I've forgotten.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: No, no, I'm sure we've never met. Though I feel that something is... awfully familiar when I'm speaking with you.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Ah, is that so... Well, that's perfectly alright...

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: The Lantern Rite... It sure is beautiful, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: This is my first time participating in the Lantern Rite. All in all, the atmosphere of the festivities is quite enjoyable.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: What fascinates me most though is the Mingxiao Lantern... Who would've thought that the people of Liyue could build a lantern so big.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: ...Watching the lighting and ascent of the Mingxiao Lantern must certainly be an unforgettable scene for everyone who participates in the Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: I'm really starting to enjoy this city... No, no, I must remain loyal to the Tsaritsa...

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: The glow of the Xiao Lanterns feels so warm...

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Even as a stranger in this foreign city, seeing the brightly lit streets and Xiao Lanterns above in the night sky still brings some indescribable warmth to my heart.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Such a warm feeling reminds me of our "Krsnik Noc" in Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: If you ever have the chance, you must visit Snezhnaya and participate in one of our festivals.

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Manager Kuan! I don't want a kite, I want a Xiao Lantern!

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: How many times do I have to tell you, just call me "Daddy."

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: If you want a Xiao Lantern, then we can just release one together. Now, if you want to write a wish on the lantern, just tell me and I'll...

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: No way! Your handwriting is terrible, Manager Kuan. If you write it, our wish will never come true!

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: Ah, child, how could you ever be so cold to your Daddy...

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: But aren't you the one who taught me to always be honest about what's on my mind?

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: And since I know that your handwriting is absolutely terrible, wouldn't I be disobeying if I told you it's fine for you to write?

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: *sigh* Fine, you're right... I'll buy you a lantern... But from now on, you must call me "Daddy."

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Alright, "Daddy"! Now, Daddy! Do as you promised!

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: Hey, this is the big day! The annual Lantern Rite is finally here!

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: All of Liyue Harbor is already bustling with excitement around us. It's not often that you'll see the city in such a festive state.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: ...But when it comes to Lantern Rite, the Mingxiao Lantern is the moment everyone's waiting for.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: On the final of Lantern Rite, they'll release the Mingxiao Lantern, built by the efforts of all the people of Liyue, and the lantern will slowly ascend into the night sky. It'll be a moment you won't want to miss.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: But I needn't say more. Take a walk around and take in all the festivities for yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: The glow of Xiao Lanterns fills the night sky, shedding light on lands below as they fly. The glow upon the sea dances before one's eyes, casting scattered lights as the waves arise...

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Hmm, casting scattered lights? No, no... That's no good! Ah, now I've got it! "flickering endlessly on the tides of night."

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Yes, yes, that's it! So, what do you think of my poem?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's great.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Hehe, I see you have good taste. My poems can set the mood even for an event as grand as the Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's a shame that those who truly grasp the subtleties of verse and rhyme are few and far between.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: I once posted my poems all around Liyue Harbor to help bring the spirit of Lantern Rite to the citizens of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: ...But before long, I was reported by the Millelith and was told that I would be arrested if I dared to post my poetry again.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Hmph, those uncultured curs, have they no taste at all!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's okay, I guess...

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Just okay? Then you must certainly be missing the deep creativity and philosophical meaning behind the words!

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: ...Hmph, such a shame.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Lantern Rite certainly is exciting. The lively atmosphere sure is different from the festivals that we have back in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: However, gourmets such as my brother and I do not revel in festivities and excitement. No, it is the delectable food and rare festival snacks we're after.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: I heard that the special dish for this year's Lantern Rite is Grilled Tiger Fish, but after trying some myself, it seems like just ordinary Grilled Tiger Fish that you can get anytime.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Perhaps only locals can distinguish the subtle variation in flavor?

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Oh, never mind. I'll just try some other snacks instead...

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: Looking for a hero? No... Looking for a mighty hero? I'm your guy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Mighty hero?

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: That's right. Heroes are always commemorated at Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: Hmph, and one day I too shall become a hero that's revered by one and all, I'm certain of it!

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: Just you wait. By this time next year, crowds will be gathering to light lanterns for me, hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But this is the festival for remembering fallen heroes.

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: Huh? You mean they don't commemorate you unless you're dead?

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: You're joking, right? I—I don't believe you!

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: W—Well then, never mind about next year's Lantern Rite...

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: In 50 years... No, in 100 years, everyone will remember this mighty hero during Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Never mind.

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: Well then don't waste my time. I've got much to do yet on my journey to becoming a mighty hero.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Have you released a Xiao Lantern yet? If you write a wish on the lantern, it's bound to come true someday.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: For example, my wish was that my daughter Little Liu would live a peaceful and healthy life, and that she'd make many friends, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: ...Perhaps you'll even be able to see the sky filled with Xiao Lanterns from atop the hills of Qingce Village.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: *sigh* Little Liu... Your daddy misses you so much...

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: For some reason, I feel that this year's Lantern Rite will be particularly magnificent.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: I was originally planning to stock up on extra materials for making Xiao Lanterns and resell them for a profit during Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: But just as I was about to purchase the materials, I found out that Ningguang had instated laws against price gouging on Xiao Lantern materials.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: If it weren't for Ningguang, I might have never realized what a shameful business scheme that was.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: So given that I couldn't make any money on the materials anyway, I decided to just give my remaining Xiao Lantern materials to Yi Zhu and Yi Xian.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: I hope that they will enjoy a lovely Lantern Rite this year.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you looking at?

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Me? Oh, I'm trying to figure out how to set this thing up...

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Which way were these lamps supposed to go... I can't remember...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to try the Illumiscreen.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: ...Again? Sorry, you'll need to wait until I've got the new lanterns ready.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to try the Illumiscreen.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: ...Again? Sorry, you'll need to wait until I've got the new lanterns ready.
